training.interpretation: A retained Adam step may be driven only by entropy/KL terms when reward advantages are zero. Counts do not establish learning or environment gain.

data.condition: Scalar physical execution with separately declared rational market reward

weighted_macro_delta.interpretation: Weighted mean of five task return changes; units are bounded task returns, not Elo or measured gradient shares.

bootstrap.method: Percentile bootstrap of 16 paired scenario families per task; seat/opponent games stay together. Independent resampling across environments for weighted mean.

data.interpretation: Fixed fresh 8B baseline versus final shared-policy weights; one training seed, descriptive uncertainty only.
caveats: Chess is capped tactical endgame return, not full-game Elo.
Market reward is d/(128+abs(d)) for the learner's integer profit difference; absolute P&L is reported separately.
Planning and coding are bounded single-player tasks; coding is AST repair, not freeform authoring.
Legal-action masking guarantees executable menu choices; validity is not a learned gain.
No pooling with the failed padded-batch condition, 27B authoring, teacher, or historical runs; five task comparisons are descriptive, not multiplicity-adjusted.
